mentions.name: TerraRose
mentions.description: A paid social media platform built without algorithmic feeds, ads, data selling, or user tracking.
mentions.problem: The builder was tired of algorithms controlling their feed, personal data being sold, ads, and being tracked on social media.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A paid social media platform called TerraRose.

https://terrarose.org

I was tired of algorithms running my feed, my data being sold, ads, being tracked.

So I built TerraRose.
